outline:
介紹晶體的各種完美結構，缺陷結構的形成與各種物理特性的相互關係，電子的波動與粒子之性質，電子於自由電子能量井，固態中行為與能帶觀念之介紹，固態材料的鬆散行為，固態的介電性質。
An introduction to Solid-State Physics in materials science.
schedule:
1. Review of modern physics
2. Solid and crystal structure
3. Reciprocal lattice
4. Free electron gas
5. Energy band
6. Tight binding method
7. Band structure and density of states
8. Lattice vibration
9. Other related topics
